title: Add per-section color variety while keeping a cohesive global theme

requirements.text: Implement a per-section theming system so each major page section uses a distinct accent color (and optionally a subtle tinted background), while the overall UI remains visually cohesive and RTL behavior stays unchanged.

quotes: نوع في الوان اريد ان تكون الوان مختلفة من قسم إلى اخر

acceptanceCriteria: Each major section (overview, energy-types, citizenship, relationship, algeria, simulators, videos, conclusion) displays a noticeably different accent color than adjacent sections.

The change is implemented via scoped CSS variable overrides (e.g., local overrides for theme tokens like --primary/--ring) so existing components that use theme tokens (e.g., text-primary, bg-primary, accent-primary) automatically inherit the section accent.
Light and dark mode both have appropriate section accent variants with readable contrast.
RTL layout, spacing, and typography are not broken or flipped by the changes.

requirements.text: Add a small, maintainable palette of section theme variants in frontend/src/index.css (e.g., 6–8 variants) that define local theme token overrides for a subtree (at minimum: --primary, --primary-foreground, --ring; optionally: --accent and --accent-foreground), with matching variants for dark mode.

quotes: نوع في الوان اريد ان تكون الوان مختلفة من قسم إلى اخر

acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/index.css contains clearly named section theme classes (or data-attribute selectors) that can be applied to a wrapper element to change the section accent color.
The variants include both light and dark overrides (e.g., via .dark .section-theme-* or equivalent), and all remain consistent with the app’s overall theme style.
No global theme tokens are removed; this only adds scoped overrides.

requirements.text: Apply the new per-section theme variants to existing sections so that each section’s card/panel styling and DecoratedHeading accent automatically reflect the section’s assigned variant.

quotes: نوع في الوان اريد ان تكون الوان مختلفة من قسم إلى اخر

acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/sections/MainContent.tsx and each relevant section component apply a section theme wrapper (class or data attribute) per section instance.
DecoratedHeading (frontend/src/components/DecoratedHeading.tsx) continues to use theme tokens (e.g., primary) and therefore changes appearance per section without introducing hard-coded colors.
Components inside sections that rely on primary styling (e.g., buttons/selection states, simulator accent bars, etc.) visually match the section accent after the wrapper is applied.
No section content text is changed; only styling/appearance is updated.

constraints: Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only).
Do not modify the immutable frontend hook files listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Keep RTL behavior unchanged across the app.
Do not introduce new backend logic; this change is frontend-only styling.
nonGoals: Redesigning app layout or adding new sections/features beyond per-section color variation.
Changing or translating existing Arabic content.
Adding new images or replacing existing generated assets.
